notes.title: Back To Home is Releasing TOMORROW
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44257914/a40ae51b8f6a0c40a5b1aa0efcb246fe03f35c55.gif[/img]

[b]Back To Home is releasing tomorrow July 12 - Friday!!!![/b]

After 4 years of development, the game is launching tomorrow. Please wishlist it to get notified when it launches. It will have 10% discount at launch. Thanks again for all the support throughout the years.  The game will get updates after launch so don`t worry. Thanks again for all the support!!!!

notes.title: Back To Home to Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Let`s gooo!!!!
The cat is joining the steam next fest. Back To Home is joining Octobers Steam Next Fest, witch is from October 9 to October 16. Back To Home will release a demo on 29 of September. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44257914/7e1b593648a5e34563878424beea1cd7880539aa.png[/img]

You will play the third level in Back To Home - The Factory. There you will be introduced to one of the puzzles in Back To Home - the moving platforms

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44257914/bccc30967c4c86b75de6cd339810985499a59196.png[/img]

You will see beautiful view along the way while discovering part of your past from the little stone houses witch you will find under special trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44257914/f5f0cefe714cc4142a5762185ce36b17316dee7a.png[/img]
